$comment: Day/night menu variants sketch. Companion to docs/ui-art/day-night-menu-spec.md. Spec only, NOT wired. Palettes and hour table are copied exactly from src/lib/menuCustom.ts (Batch B, PR #60); per-menu rows and tint-strength scaling are SPEC PROPOSALS, not current code behaviour. Locked default title + v32 main menu are EXEMPT: no variant applies to them without Mars's explicit yes.

exempt.lockedMainMenuV32: No day/night variant at any hour, in any mode. V32 placements (logo y180 w900, cloud (600,738) 700x180, buttons y788/918/1008/1098) never move.
exempt.lockedTitle: No day/night variant at any hour, in any mode. Logo is the uploaded logo PNG, never font text.

gradualTransition.midnightNote: No blend at 0:00: NITE ends at 23 and LATE renders as NITE, so there is no visual jump at midnight.
gradualTransition.rule: During the last hour of a period, blend toward the next period by minute/60.

battle.detail: No sky gradient: battle sits over game art.

dialogue.detail: Dialogue box already reads Batch B CSS vars today; no sky gradient over the world.

main-menu.applies: Preset menus ONLY. NEVER the locked v32 default without Mars's explicit yes.

pause.note: Day/night tint while pausing is still a Batch B NEED (PauseMenu has no Settings entry yet); this row specs the target, it does not claim it works today.

settings.note: The one menu Batch B already tints today.

modes.AUTO: Device clock at render (no simulated in-game clock exists yet).
modes.CUSTOM: Player-picked period overrides the DISPLAY period only; does not advance a game clock.

notSpecifiedReason: No Y2K skin preset exists for those menus yet (PR #151 covers the 8 above); their rows wait for their skin presets rather than being guessed here.
sharedRules: Only panel, accent, text/muted, backdrop sky gradient, and tint overlay change with the period.
Nothing moves, nothing resizes, no label text changes.
Button colour identity never changes: pink CONTINUE stays pink, yellow NEW GAME stays yellow.
Where a menu sits over game art (battle, dialogue over the world), there is no sky gradient: only panel + accent + tint change.

source.palettesFrom: src/lib/menuCustom.ts DAY_NIGHT_COLOURWAYS (original Mochiichao colourways, not Pokemon palettes)
source.periodsFrom: HeartGold gf_rtc hour table, as transcribed in src/lib/menuCustom.ts TIME_OF_DAY_BY_HOUR

tintStrengthProposal: SPEC PROPOSAL, not in code yet: strength 0-100 scales the tint overlay alpha only (100 = alpha above, 50 = half, 0 = no overlay). Tint never recolours the logo or button labels and never moves any element.
